items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: I enjoyed listening to Artie Shaw much better than at times listening to Benny... But it was something about Artie Shaw's playing that I enjoy even a little bit more.

ctx.x: I don't think he was the king, as they called him, because personally -- nothing against him as a person, or anything like that -- but if I must say so, I enjoyed listening to Artie Shaw much better than at times listening to Benny, although Benny was great. I enjoyed listening and playing with Benny, of course. But it was something about Artie Shaw's playing that I enjoy even a little bit more.
Do you think it was because Shaw was more sophistically harmonically?
